name: OneOf2 / OneOf3 forwarding of registry traits

test_list.description: OneOf2<A, B> implements EventStore by calling only the active variant.
OneOf3 implements Redactor; the third variant's output is used when it is active.
OneOf2 implements ChatModel; its stream yields the active variant's chunks in order.
Every registry error enum implements HasKind; representative variants map to Transient / Permanent / Policy / Fatal as documented.

inputs.name: backend
inputs.description: Runtime-selected backend wrapped for static dispatch (no dyn).

output_type: same as the forwarded trait method
output_description: Identical behaviour to calling the active variant directly.
